therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Stimulating immune response against MUC1-expressing breast cancer cells

biomarker_changes: CA 15-3 levels measured as possible immune response marker
safety_signals: Intestinal obstruction (1/11 patients in treatment arm)
results.dose_information: Tecemotide 1000 micrograms (930 micrograms delivered) subcutaneously weekly for 8 weeks, then every 6 weeks until progression. Pretreatment with cyclophosphamide 300 mg/m² IV (max 600 mg)

context.comparator: Placebo plus hormonal therapy with saline pretreatment
context.duration: Treatment until progressive disease, trial duration approximately 11 months
